parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL OUTPUT VOLTAGE RAIL MISMATCH: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is a fixed 3.3 V LDO (p.7) vs LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB at fixed 5 V (p.7); swapping delivers the wrong rail voltage and risks damaging downstream loads.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 10 µF, p.3), whereas LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.3–22 Ω (p.15)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB can trigger control-loop oscillation.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 103% higher on AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 125 °C/W p.4 vs LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB: 61.6 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB requires Vin,min >= 6.5 V (p.7) vs 4.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: -20..125 °C Extended Commercial (-20°C to +125°C TJ — NOT -40°C Industrial) vs LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ, LM1117I grade)); AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 cold limit only -20 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) and LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to fixed LDO output voltage rail mismatch (3.3 V vs 5 V). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 31.9 °C on AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (θJA 125 °C/W) vs 15.7 °C on LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB (θJA 61.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.3x ratio (4000 µA (p.7) vs 5000 µA (p.8)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 "Operating Temperature Stops at -20°C — NOT Rated for -40°C Industrial Grade" (p.4) and LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB "Fixed 5.0 V Rail — Requires >= 6.5 V VIN (NEVER Swap Into 3.3 V LM1117IMPX-3.3 Sockets)" (p.7). BOM decision: Choose AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 when your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors; choose LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB when lower package θJA (61.6 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
